purpose: Correct the rejected V1 oracle input semantics and run only the 20 privileged deadline-missing packet-repair arms needed to finish the frozen mechanism gate.

failure_diagnosis.root_cause: The V1 sidecar complement included a first primary packet received only after the deadline because receiver state was created lazily. It therefore omitted one deadline-late packet from 12,456 plans.

sidecar_derivation.inclusive_deadline_rule: If union_first_packet_us is empty or greater than generation_time_us + deadline_us, no recorded source packet is timely. Otherwise the deadline-timely set is link_1_source_packet_indices.
sidecar_derivation.repair_plan: The complement of the deadline-timely primary source-packet set over [0, source_packet_count).
sidecar_derivation.late_first_arrival_rule: A baseline first packet strictly after the integer-microsecond deadline is excluded from the timely set; all source packets are then repaired.
sidecar_derivation.wire_format: Retain the canonical ten-column packet-outcome CSV understood by the frozen executable, while replacing union, copy-0, and link-1 sets with the derived deadline-timely set and replacing the missing set with its complement.

validity.paired_potential_interpretation: This is privileged replay of the paired no-repair deadline potential, not an implementable causal policy and not a claim that treatment leaves receiver-level primary arrival timing unchanged.
validity.prohibited_claim: Do not call this an exact within-run omniscient oracle if receiver-level primary packet sets differ.

outcomes.primary: All-generated deadline misses over every generated frame.
outcomes.resource: Measured total target-sender PHY TX airtime over both links.

decision.original_equal_airtime_test: The repaired arm must have fewer misses than STR and a paired measured sender-airtime ratio <= 1.0.
decision.engineering_sensitivity: Also report whether it has fewer misses than STR at sender-airtime ratio <= 1.20; this does not replace the original equal-airtime test.
decision.primary_only_airtime_floor_warning: The observed 5 GHz-only primary already consumes 1.1682x STR airtime, so any repair has little headroom under 1.20.
decision.no_static_projection_substitution: A static cost or rescue projection may accompany but cannot replace the new closed-loop replay.
